# Greenwood Marketing Collective

> Greenwood Marketing Collective is the marketing strategy practice of Courtney Greenwood, founded in 2024. Courtney has 20+ years in marketing, product marketing, and strategy, with deep roots in healthcare and health tech. She helps startup founders, in-house marketing and product teams, and small businesses with product marketing, go-to-market strategy, messaging and positioning, and fractional CMO support. Based in Massachusetts, working remotely with clients anywhere.

Key facts:
- 50+ clients and startups advised
- Helped shape the market narrative behind CentralReach's $1.6B acquisition
- BA in Journalism (University of Rhode Island), MBA in Marketing (Suffolk University), former adjunct marketing professor (College of Charleston)
- Hourly "Pick My Brain" advisory sessions: $150 per hour, with 3-hour ($425) and 5-hour ($675) bundles. No retainer required.
- All engagements start with an inquiry form; there are no free strategy calls.
